## Checklist

- [ ] Pull request targets `develop` (release pull requests target `main`).
- [ ] Related issue and acceptance criteria are addressed.
- [ ] Relevant tests/checks pass, or missing checks are explained.
- [ ] API/docs/schema changes are updated and affected teams notified.
- [ ] No secrets, private child data, raw recordings, or unapproved datasets are included.
- [ ] Safety/privacy impacts have been considered.
- [ ] A teammate review is requested; merge only after approval and passing required checks.
